product.title: Norix Attenda - Floor Mounted Patient Bed - Rotationally Molded Ligature Resistant - Model ATN101 / ATN103
product.body_html:
The Norix Attenda Floor Mounted Bed is designed and engineered to be ligature resistant and to exceed the expectations of practitioners who have tried everything. It mounts in a corner, against a wall or free standing. Sturdy and seamless, the Norix Attenda bed features a raised lip around the bed deck for easy clean-up.

  • Fabrication and Material:
    • Slightly textured maintenance free surface allows for easy cleaning
    • Rotationally molded, ligature resistant, specially formulated, high-impact polyethylene with ultraviolet light stabilizers (to reduce fading)
    • Chemically resistant to blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution and chlorine solution
    • Anti-ligature design with no internal openings
    • Premium TruColor polymer is fully compounded for superior color consistency and durability
    • Unit is filled with rigid polyurethane foam for increased durability and sound absorption
  • Overall size: 40"W x 84"L x 15.5"H
  • Mattress deck: 38"W x 82"L
  • Models:
    • ATN101 - Standard Bed (wt. 110 lbs)
    • ATN101B - Free-Standing Bed with Bottom Closure Panel (wt. 115 lbs)
    • ATN103 - Standard Bed with No Mounting Holes (wt. 110 lbs)
    • ATN103B - Free-Standing Bed with No Mounting Holes and Bottom Closure Panel (wt. 108 lbs) 
  • Available options:
    • ATN102-K - Platform Bed Riser 
    • ATN110 - Headboard
    • Restraint Rings (to be used with floor-mount beds ATN101 and ATN101B only, restraint straps sold separately)
      • ATN-R01N - Restraint Rings
      • ATN-R06N - 6-piece Restraint Rings
      • ATN-RR01K-01 - Removable Restraint Rings
      • ATN-RR06K-01 - 6-piece Removable Restraint Rings
    • ATN-G103 - Non-Removable Glides
    • ATN106-0001 - Enclosure Kit (ATN101 only)
    • Mattress - recommended size 38” x 82”
  • Mounting hardware not included
  • 10 year limited warranty
  • Colors: Twilight, Cove, Sand, Sienna, Dove
  • Made in the USA

What are the advantages of Norix Attenda Bedroom Furniture?

  • Ligature-resistant design
  • Contraband-resistant
  • Easy to clean
  • Extremely durable
  • Foam filled reinforcement
  • Rounded edges
  • Infection control

About Norix Furniture:
Norix Group specializes in providing high quality, intensive-use institutional furniture designed specifically for behavioral health care facilities, hospitals, jails, prisons, detention centers, and other challenging markets. Norix humanizes behavioral and correctional facilities, while building extreme durability and security into each piece of institutional furniture so it stands up to correctional grade use. Norix furniture is as tough as your prison or detention grade environment, yet safe for trustees and staff. Anchortex supplies the complete line of Norix furniture for patient rooms, classrooms, inmate cells, day rooms, lobbies, intake areas, chapels, dining halls, outdoor/recreation, contact visitation and video-visitation areas, as well as public safety furniture for police and fire stations that looks good and stands up to hard use. Norix meets or exceeds testing requirements for intensive-use institutional and detention grade furniture, and the everyday test of use at healthcare and detention institutions by people who don't necessarily have the best interests of the institutional furniture in mind.
